verses.text: The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, saying, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Moise i-a zis lui the people, Remember this day, in which you came out of Egipt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of mână the DOMNUL brought you out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.
Today you să plece out in the month Abib.

It shall be, when the DOMNUL brings you into the țară of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a țară flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.
Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the DOMNUL. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which the DOMNUL did for me when I came out of Egipt.’ (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
It shall be for a sign to you on your mână, and for a memorial between your eyes, that the DOMNUL’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong mână the DOMNUL has brought you out of Egipt.
You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
It shall be, when the DOMNUL brings you into the țară of the Canaanite, as he swore to you and to your fathers, and will give it to you,

that you shall set apart to the DOMNUL all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have. The males shall be the DOMNUL’s. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of mână the DOMNUL brought us out from Egipt, from the house of bondage.

When Faraon stubbornly refused to let us să plece, the DOMNUL killed all the firstborn in the țară of Egipt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to the DOMNUL all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’
It shall be for a sign on your mână, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of mână the DOMNUL brought us out of Egipt.

When Faraon had let the people să plece, Dumnezeu didn’t lead them by the way of the țară of the Philistines, although that was near; for Dumnezeu a zis, Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and they return to Egipt;
but Dumnezeu led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the țară of Egipt.

Moise took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, Dumnezeu will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might să plece by day and by night:
the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
